name: CaseBoxShadowInsetHairline
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "box-shadow-inset-hairline" (effects). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a stack that MIXES a drop layer with an `inset` hairline — astryx `shadow-med`'s third layer, the 1px inner ring every menu card and toast carries
